name: الطبائع
roots: طبيعة (ṭabīʿa, ط-ب-ع: the stamp a thing is struck with at its making); الجسم وما ليس بجسم (the body, and what is not a body)

name: جِسْم
roots: جسم (ج-س-م: to be bulky; Ibn Sina: الجسم جوهر يمكن أن تُفرض فيه أبعاد ثلاثة — a substance in which three dimensions may be posited); جَسَد (jasad: a body, living or dead)

name: المَعْنى
roots: معنى (ع-ن-ي: to intend, to mean — the philosophers' word nearest λεκτόν); قول (qawl: a saying); اعتبار (iʿtibār: what is by being posited, as a contract or an office is)

name: الطبيعة
roots: ط-ب-ع (the stamp a thing is struck with)

name: الجِنْس
roots: ج-ن-س (to be alike; jins perhaps from γένος through Syriac); نوع (nawʿ: a species)

name: الأجناس
roots: جنس (a kind)

name: الخطوط
roots: خ-ط-ط (to draw a line)

name: الإطار
roots: أ-ط-ر (to bend round: a rim, a frame)

name: المادة
roots: م-د-د (to stretch, to supply); هيولى (hayūlā: prime matter, from ὕλη)

name: الجاذبية
roots: ج-ذ-ب (to draw, to pull)

name: الأحياء
roots: ح-ي-ي (to live)

name: النطق
roots: ن-ط-ق (to speak: speech and reason at once); الحيوان الناطق (the speaking animal: the philosophers' rendering of ζῷον λογικόν)

name: المصنوعات
roots: ص-ن-ع (to make, to craft)

name: الشروط
roots: ش-ر-ط (a condition)

name: الاعتدال
roots: ع-د-ل (to be even); ابن سينا: اعتدال المزاج

name: التناسب
roots: ن-س-ب (to relate)

name: القواعد
roots: ق-ع-د (to sit: قاعدة, a base and a rule)

name: الوزن
roots: و-ز-ن (to weigh); الميزان (the balance)

name: مراتب الأجسام
roots: ر-ت-ب (to stand firm in its place: a rank); Ibn Miskawayh: minerals, plants, animals, the highest of each order touching the lowest of the next

name: الزمكان
roots: زمان + مكان: the Arabic word for spacetime joins the two into one

name: حَقْل القُوّة
roots: حقل (ḥaql: a sown field); قوّة (quwwa: strength) — a field that binds or gives mass

name: حَقْل المادّة
roots: حقل; مادّة (mādda: the stuff of a thing) — a field that takes room and excludes

name: جُسَيْم أوَّلي
roots: جُسَيْم (jusaym: a little body, the diminutive of جسم); الجزء الذي لا يتجزّأ (the part that is not divided: the atom of the kalām)

name: هادرون
roots: ἁδρός (stout); كوارك (quark)

name: النَّواة
roots: ن-و-ي (a date-stone — and, from the same root, نيّة, an intention: the kernel and the intent)

name: الذَّرّة
roots: ذ-ر-ر (to scatter: a mote in a sunbeam); الجوهر الفرد (the single substance: the atom of the mutakallimūn)

name: الجُزَيْء
roots: جُزَيْء (juzayʾ: a little part, the diminutive of جزء); ج-ز-أ (to divide into parts)

name: الخَلِيّة
roots: خليّة (a beehive, a cell); خ-ل-و (to be empty: a hollow)

name: النَّسيج
roots: ن-س-ج (to weave)

name: العُضْو
roots: ع-ض-و (to part into members); آلة (āla: an instrument — the philosophers' ὄργανον)

name: الكائن الحيّ
roots: ك-و-ن (to be, to come to be); ح-ي-ي (to live); الجسم ذو النفس (the ensouled body, of the philosophers)

name: الجَماعة
roots: ج-م-ع (to gather); قطيع (qaṭīʿ: a herd)

name: المُجْتَمَع الأحيائي
roots: ج-م-ع (to gather); ح-ي-ي (to live)

name: النِّظام البيئي
roots: ن-ظ-م (to string pearls on a thread: an order); بيئة (bīʾa, ب-و-أ: a place one settles in)

name: النطق
roots: ن-ط-ق (to speak: speech and reason at once); الحيوان الناطق (the speaking animal: the philosophers' rendering of ζῷον λογικόν)

name: الخامة
roots: خامة (raw stuff, a material); المادة (the line it is on)

name: الجِرْم السَّماوي
roots: جِرْم (a body, the astronomers' word); سماء (samāʾ, س-م-و: what is high)

name: النظام الكوكبي
roots: كوكب (a star, a planet); ن-ظ-م (an order, pearls on a thread)

name: المجرّة
roots: ج-ر-ر (to drag: the trail drawn across the sky); درب التبانة (the straw-sellers' path: the Milky Way)

name: المُكَوِّن
roots: ك-و-ن (to be: what brings a whole to be); قطعة (qiṭʿa: a piece)

name: الآلة
roots: آلة (āla: an instrument, a machine — what one works by); جهاز (jihāz: equipment)

name: التاج
roots: تاج (a crown, from Persian)

name: واجب الوجود
roots: و-ج-ب (to fall due, to be necessary); و-ج-د (to find: وجود, being); ابن سينا: واجب الوجود بذاته — عقل وعاقل ومعقول، وعاشق ومعشوق

name: المَحَبّة
roots: ح-ب-ب (love — and حَبّة, a seed); الرحمة (raḥma, from رَحِم, the womb: the love that gives life; وَرَحْمَتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ, my mercy embraces all things, 7:156)

name: الحكمة
roots: ح-ك-م (to judge, to hold back — حَكَمة, the bit that holds a horse); الحكيم (the Wise, among the names of God)

name: بواسطة
roots: و-س-ط (the middle: واسطة, an intermediary); سبب (sabab: first a rope let down, then a cause — what one reaches by)

name: الحال
roots: ح-و-ل (to turn, to change: a state is where a turning stands for now)

name: الأبعاد
roots: ب-ع-د (to be far)

name: الزمان
roots: زمان (from Persian zamān); الدهر (al-dahr: time without end)

name: الطول
roots: ط-و-ل (to be long, to last)

name: مَتى
roots: متى (when: one of the ten categories, المقولات العشر)

name: أَيْن
roots: أين (where: the category); مكان (makān, from ك-و-ن, to be: the where a thing is)

name: المُتَمِّمات
roots: ت-م-م (to be complete)

name: مُصَرَّح به
roots: ص-ر-ح (to be pure, clear: to say plainly)

name: الحامِل
roots: ح-م-ل (to carry); الموضوع (al-mawḍūʿ: the subject, what is laid under — the philosophers' ὑποκείμενον)

name: النِّظام
roots: ن-ظ-م (to string pearls on a thread)

name: القِسْمة
roots: ق-س-م (to divide, to apportion — قِسْم, a part); النقطة (the dot)

name: القِسَم
roots: ق-س-م (to apportion)

name: جُزءٌ من
roots: ج-ز-أ (to divide into parts); الكُلّ (the whole)

name: يَسْكُن في
roots: س-ك-ن (to be still, to dwell: سَكَن, a dwelling and a rest)

name: يقع في
roots: و-ق-ع (to fall, to come to lie); موضع (mawḍiʿ, و-ض-ع: where a thing is put)

name: المالِك
roots: م-ل-ك (to possess)

name: المسؤول
roots: س-أ-ل (to ask): the one who will be asked

name: الاقتناء
roots: ق-ن-ي (to acquire, to keep); الشراء (a purchase)

name: وجوه الرعاية
roots: ر-ع-ي (to tend, to shepherd: رعاية, care); وجه (a face)

name: قانوني
roots: قانون (from κανών, a rule)

name: تقني
roots: τέχνη, through تقنية

name: التجربة
roots: ج-ر-ب (to try)

name: مالي
roots: م-و-ل (wealth)

name: الأفعال
roots: ف-ع-ل (to do)

name: مصنوع
roots: ص-ن-ع (to make, to craft)

name: مُشْتَقّ
roots: ش-ق-ق (to split: split off from its source)

name: مقروء
roots: ق-ر-أ (to read, to recite — held by some to be first to gather together)

name: مَقول
roots: ق-و-ل (to say)

name: الإسناد
roots: س-ن-د (to lean on: a report leans on the one who said it, named, and on the one before); المصدر (al-maṣdar: where a thing comes out)

name: الطبقات
roots: ط-ب-ق (to cover, to fit one upon another: a layer, a generation)

name: البيان
roots: ب-ي-ن (to be distinct, clear: a declaration that makes plain)

name: القانون
roots: κανών (a straight rod, a rule); ناموس (nāmūs: the philosophers' word for a city's law, from νόμος)

name: التعليل
roots: ع-ل-ل (a cause, عِلّة): the giving of causes

name: اليوميّة
roots: يوم (a day): دفتر اليومية, the daybook; دفتر (daftar, from διφθέρα)

name: التاريخ
roots: أ-ر-خ (to date)

name: قائمة الانتظار
roots: ن-ظ-ر (to look, to wait for); مُعَلَّق (muʿallaq: hanging, suspended)

name: الأسماء
roots: س-م-و (to rise: a name raised over a thing, as the Basrans held — the Kufans: و-س-م, a mark); وعلّم آدم الأسماء كلها (He taught Adam the names, all of them, 2:31)

name: المَنْظَر
roots: ن-ظ-ر (to look, to consider): a view, an elevation

name: العَدَسات
roots: عَدَس (lentils)

name: التَّعَرُّف
roots: ع-ر-ف (to know, to recognise); المشرق (where the sun rises)

name: الفَهْم
roots: ف-ه-م (to grasp)

name: التشغيل
roots: ش-غ-ل (to occupy, to keep at work)

name: الفَحْص
roots: ف-ح-ص (to search, to dig into)

name: الحَديقة
roots: ح-د-ق (to surround: a garden walled round); الجنّة (al-janna, ج-ن-ن: a garden, what is covered by its trees)

name: الاسم
roots: س-م-و (to rise); و-س-م (a mark)

name: مِن قِبَل
roots: قِبَل (qibal: the side facing one): from the side of — how Modern Arabic names the doer of a passive, as از سوی and tarafından; الفاعل (al-fāʿil: the grammarians' doer, the subject of a verb with an object or without one — Pāṇini's kartṛ)

name: مُتَعَلَّق
roots: ع-ل-ق (to hang upon): what an act hangs upon — the word of the kalām and the uṣūl for what an act or a knowing is of (مُتَعَلَّق العِلم, مُتَعَلَّق الحُكم): what the act reaches, or what it is about; المفعول به (the grammarians' object, what the act falls upon); الموضوع is kept by the philosophers for the subject, ὑποκείμενον

name: عن طريق
roots: طريق (ṭarīq: a road, a way): by way of — a tool, a document, words, a link, an agreement, as از راهِ and yoluyla; باء الاستعانة (the bi- of the instrument); بواسطة was term:via's, which `come` now takes

name: إلى
roots: إلى (ilā: to, towards — the grammarians' انتهاء الغاية, the end an extent reaches): what it goes towards, or the one it is for; لِـ (li-: for, the lām of the one it is for)

name: مِن
roots: مِن (min: from — the grammarians' ابتداء الغاية, the beginning of an extent): the fixed point it departs from — a source, a giver, a parent

name: في
roots: في (fī: in, at): the grammarians' ظرف (ẓarf: a vessel), المفعول فيه — that in which it is done: where and when, which in an order, or the being it stands on, runs on or is kept at; عند (ʿinda: at, beside)

name: بِصِفَة
roots: و-ص-ف (to describe): صِفة (ṣifa: a description, a quality) — in the capacity of, as what; الحال (al-ḥāl: the grammarians' circumstantial, the state in which); كـ (ka-: like)

name: قَوْل
roots: ق-و-ل (to say): to give one's word — the act whose deed is مَقول (acts:said)

name: قِراءة
roots: ق-ر-أ (to read, to recite — held by some to be first to gather): what a body read off a thing, a gauge, a page — whose deed is مقروء (acts:read)

name: اشتِقاق
roots: ش-ق-ق (to split): split off from what was given — whose deed is مُشتَقّ (acts:derived); استنباط (istinbāṭ: drawing water up from a well — the jurists' derivation)

name: صُنْع
roots: ص-ن-ع (to make, to craft): made here — from nothing given, or out of what it copies — whose deed is مصنوع (acts:made)

name: كَوْن
roots: ك-و-ن (to be): in the kalām, a body's كون is its being in a place (الحصول في الحيّز) — where a being is, at a position or at a being; the philosophers' الكون والفساد (coming to be and passing away) is another sense; يقع في (term:located_at, which `be` replaces)

name: قِيام
roots: ق-و-م (to stand, to rise): قيام الشيء بغيره, a thing's subsisting on another — the philosophers' قيام العرض بالجوهر (an accident standing on its substance): what a step stands on, made of it or possible on it

name: جُزْء
roots: ج-ز-أ (to divide into portions): a part of a whole — the noun stands, as جزء does in Persian, where Arabic has no masdar for being a part; جزءٌ من (term:part_of, which `part` replaces); جزئي (a particular) is the logicians', not this

name: تَسْمِية
roots: س-م-و (to rise: a name raised over a thing) — a namespace names a being, once or more; و-س-م (a mark, as the Kufans held)

name: صُدُور
roots: ص-د-ر (to issue, to go forth): through whom a being came to be — the falāsifa's صدور, beings issuing one through another, every chain ending at واجب الوجود (crown:theone); بواسطة (term:via, which `come` replaces)

name: مِلْكِيّة
roots: م-ل-ك (to possess, to rule): owning — whose a being is, one owner; المالِك (term:owned_by, which `own` replaces)

name: مَسْؤوليّة
roots: س-أ-ل (to ask): being the one who will be asked — who answers for a being, and in which mode; المسؤول (term:responsibility, which `answer` replaces)

name: اقتِناء
roots: ق-ن-ي (to acquire, to keep): from whom a being came to us — bought, rented, given, lent, inherited; الاقتناء (term:acquired, which `acquire` replaces); الشراء (a purchase: one way of the five)

name: عُبُور
roots: ع-ب-ر (to cross over): statements carried from one layer to another; انتقال (intiqāl: a transfer — of property too)

name: واجب
roots: و-ج-ب (to fall due, to be necessary): Ibn Sina's wājib — what cannot not be; the crown's own word (واجب الوجود, crown:theone); the fiqh's wājib (obligatory) is kept apart, and the permission square says إلزامي

name: ممكن خاص
roots: م-ك-ن (to have room, to be able): the logicians' special possibility (الإمكان الخاص) — neither necessary nor impossible: what may be and may not be

name: ممكن
roots: م-ك-ن (to have room, to be able): Ibn Sina's mumkin in its general sense (الإمكان العام) — what is not impossible

name: ممتنع
roots: م-ن-ع (to withhold): Ibn Sina's mumtaniʿ — what cannot be

name: إلزامي
roots: ل-ز-م (to cling, to be bound): binding — a clause's must; واجب, the fiqh's word, is kept by the necessity square for Ibn Sina's wājib

name: جائز الترك
roots: ج-و-ز (to pass, to be allowed) + ترك (tark: a leaving): the uṣūlīs' own phrase — the obligatory is what may not be left (ما لا يجوز تركه), and what may be left is جائز الترك

name: جائز
roots: ج-و-ز (to pass, to be allowed): what is not forbidden — the uṣūlīs' general jāʾiz; مباح (mubāḥ) is narrower, the indifferent, both permitted and omissible

name: محظور
roots: ح-ظ-ر (to fence in): barred — the jurists' synonym of حرام; ممنوع is passed over so the two squares do not share م-ن-ع with ممتنع

name: مُوافَقة
roots: و-ف-ق (to fit, to suit): each party's yes; قبول (qabūl: the fiqh's acceptance, answering an offer, إيجاب)

name: رَفْض
roots: ر-ف-ض (to cast off): a party's no

name: دَفْع
roots: د-ف-ع (to push, to hand over): to give an amount; أداء (adāʾ: discharging what is owed)

name: تَحَمُّل
roots: ح-م-ل (to carry): bearing a cost, in a share — تحمّل النفقات (to bear the costs)

name: إذْن
roots: أ-ذ-ن (the ear: to give ear, to permit): leave given — read, write, enact or ratify; جائز (permitted) is the square's

name: استِطاعة
roots: ط-و-ع (to obey, to be able): being able — the theologians' استطاعة, the capacity to act; may, or must, as the square says; بند (a clause, what a `can` in words is)

name: نِيابة
roots: ن-و-ب (to take one's turn): acting in another's stead, who is bound by what is done — نائب (a deputy); الوكالة (wakāla: the fiqh's agency)

name: احتِياج
roots: ح-و-ج (to be in want): needing something to function — how badly is a position on the necessity square

name: تَلْبِية
roots: ل-ب-ي (to answer a call — the pilgrims' labbayk, here I am): تلبية الحاجة, meeting a need

name: استِعمال
roots: ع-م-ل (to work): putting to work — a being, an allowance, a technology; استخدام (istikhdām: putting into service — the root of خدمة, kept for `serve`)

name: وَظِيفة
roots: و-ظ-ف (to assign a daily portion): a function, a job — a router's, a file server's; the noun stands, as کار and görev do

name: احتِواء
roots: ح-و-ي (to gather in, to contain): what a being can hold, and what it holds; سعة (saʿa: room — what it can hold only)

name: تَنْفِيذ
roots: ن-ف-ذ (to pierce through, to carry out): a machine runs an operating system, a program, an instance; التشغيل is view_lenses:operate's

name: فَتْح
roots: ف-ت-ح (to open): a session, an account opened

name: تَسْيِير
roots: س-ي-ر (to go, to travel): making a case go along its course — سيرة (a course); نقل (naql: moving a body from place to place) is not this

name: خُطْوة
roots: خ-ط-و (to stride): a step of a walk, the line a case moves along — the noun stands, as گام and adım do

name: حُضُور
roots: ح-ض-ر (to be present): being present at an event, which takes the hours of those present

name: قِياس
roots: ق-ي-س (to measure — and the logicians' syllogism, the jurists' analogy): reading a property of a being, at a moment, through an instrument

name: تَسْجِيل
roots: س-ج-ل (a scroll, a register — سِجِلّ): what a line held, written down position by position

name: إحْصاء
roots: ح-ص-ي (pebbles: to count by pebbles): a reckoning declared, read each time it is asked and never stored; حساب (an account) is kept for the books

name: تَثْبِيت
roots: ث-ب-ت (to stand fast): fixing the moment and the commit a reading was read at

name: تَصْنِيف
roots: ص-ن-ف (a kind, a sort): setting a being in its class by a code of a scheme

name: شَأْن
roots: ش-أ-ن (an affair, a concern): صاحب الشأن, the person concerned — the person a record is about; بشأن (concerning); the owner is another question (`own`)

name: حَوْلَ
roots: ح-و-ل (to turn about): what a record speaks of, around which it turns; the person it is personal to is شأن

name: تقدير الحساسية
roots: ق-د-ر (to measure out) + ح-س-س (to feel): how much harm a being can do a person if it leaves the garden

name: تَعَطُّل
roots: ع-ط-ل (to stand idle): a way a being can break down, or is breaking down

name: إصلاح
roots: ص-ل-ح (to be sound): setting a failure right, where the fix lives

name: حُكْم
roots: ح-ك-م (to judge, to hold back): a person's ruling on a disagreement — the statements disputed, and the one chosen

name: إجابة
roots: ج-و-ب (to answer — first to cut through): an observer's verdict on another's reading — it confirms, disputes or abstains — or a speaker's own words at a hearing

name: مُوازَنة
roots: و-ز-ن (to weigh): weighing criteria against each other, pair by pair; الوزن (foundation_rules:weight) is a body's own

name: اقتِراح
roots: ق-ر-ح (to bring forth anew): beans offered to another garden, under an agreement

name: اسْتِلام
roots: س-ل-م (to hand over safe): receiving a proposal in, whole; قبول (qabūl: acceptance) is not this — taking in is not accepting

name: تَمْرِين
roots: م-ر-ن (to be supple, to be practised): a rehearsal, a drill — a garden holding no facts about the world; اختبار (a test)

name: استِماع
roots: س-م-ع (to hear): listening at an address and a port, through a protocol, as a خادم (khādim: a servant — Arabic's word for a server) does; خدمة is kept for the kind `service`

name: حَمْل
roots: ح-م-ل (to carry): a link carries a tunnel, a disk a volume — الموجة الحاملة (the carrier wave); الحامِل (complements:bearer) is another sense

name: تَوْجِيه
roots: و-ج-ه (a face: to turn towards): traffic sent on to its next hop — Arabic networking's word for routing

name: ترجمة عناوين الشبكة
roots: ت-ر-ج-م (to render) + عنوان (ʿunwān: an address — and a title, which the plural and the network keep apart): network address translation, an address rewritten as traffic crosses

name: تَصْفِية
roots: ص-ف-و (to be clear, pure): letting traffic cross or stopping it — تصفية الحزم (packet filtering); جدار ناري (a firewall)

name: قَيْد
roots: ق-ي-د (to fetter: what is bound down in the books): القيد المحاسبي, an amount moved from one account to another, or booked to an analytic account in a share

name: مُطابَقة
roots: ط-ب-ق (to fit one upon another): المطابقة البنكية — a bank's line and the payment said, one movement counted once

name: تَجْدِيد
roots: ج-د-د (to be new): a registration renewed

name: تَحْدِيد
roots: ح-د-د (to set a limit: حدّ, a boundary): a cell's boundary fixed by a mark at a position

name: إنشاء
roots: ن-ش-أ (to arise, to grow): bringing into being an artifact — a file, a build, a report; and the art of composing words (الإنشاء)

name: رَسْم
roots: ر-س-م (to trace, to mark): a page draws — each drawing a رسم of what it draws

name: قَناة
roots: قناة (a channel, a conduit — and a spear-shaft): what a listening surface, a link or a treatment is as a channel

name: مُعادِل
roots: ع-د-ل (to make even): what a payment came to in another currency

name: فِئة
roots: ف-ي-ء (a band, a group): a class of the Contract of Parts; تصنيف is `classify`'s

name: بَنْد
roots: بند (band, from Persian: a tie, a clause): what a clause holds beside its words — when it falls due, how it repeats, its window

name: شُمُول
roots: ش-م-ل (to enfold): which parts of what a grant covers it opens, and whether each use states a reason

name: مُخَطَّط
roots: خ-ط-ط (to draw lines): a drawing — the mapping or being it draws, its story and its lenses

name: مَنْهَج
roots: ن-ه-ج (a plain road): how a reading was made; طريقة (a way) shares ط-ر-ق with the role `through`

name: صَفْحة
roots: ص-ف-ح (a broad flat face): a page of drawings

name: مَوْضِع
roots: و-ض-ع (to lay, to put): where a thing is put — what a placement holds there, how well its position is known, its window

name: وُجود
roots: و-ج-د (to find): found, or looked for and not found — being is what is found; حضور is kept for `attend`

name: اسْتِعْلام
roots: ع-ل-م (to know): seeking to know — a query, what a reckoning selects and computes, read each time; قراءة is `read`'s

name: نَتِيجة
roots: ن-ت-ج (to bring forth young): what came of a measuring — a code

name: اِتِّجاه
roots: و-ج-ه (to face): along a move's direction, or against it

name: سِلْسِلة
roots: س-ل-س-ل (a chain): a series — what a line held at each position, its rows

name: تَسْوِية
roots: س-و-ي (to make level): which occurrences of which clauses a payment settles, and how much of each

name: حِصّة
roots: ح-ص-ص (to fall to one's lot): one's portion of a cost

name: إشغال الوقت
roots: ش-غ-ل (to occupy) + وقت (time): whether it takes the hours — مشغول (opaque) or فارغ (transparent)

name: قِيمة
roots: ق-و-م (to stand up, to be worth): the value a measuring read, with how well it is known

name: مَسْلَك
roots: س-ل-ك (to go along a path): how a walk goes at a step — who acts, how long, the ways out

name: مُقارَنات
roots: ق-ر-ن (to join, to pair): the comparisons, pair by pair — the judgments a weighing writes

name: مُعَرِّف
roots: ع-ر-ف (to know, to recognise): what a statement is known by in its bean, so another can take it as a filler

name: ما دام
roots: د-و-م (to last): as long as — the statement holds while what it names matches

name: سَبَب
roots: س-ب-ب (a rope let down, then a cause — what one reaches by): the reason, in prose; التعليل (layers:reasoning) is the law's own

name: مُلاحَظة
roots: ل-ح-ظ (to glance at): a remark, in prose

name: مَحْفوظ
roots: ح-ف-ظ (to guard, to keep): kept off git, in a store a host resolves — this is its pointer; اللوح المحفوظ (the Preserved Tablet)

name: مستودع الشيفرة
roots: و-د-ع (to lay down in trust: a depository) + شيفرة (code, through French chiffre from Arabic ṣifr, a cipher, zero): a codebase

name: مُنْتَج
roots: ن-ت-ج (to bring forth): a product — a program made to be used, sold or given

name: مُنَظَّمة
roots: ن-ظ-م (to string pearls on a thread): an organisation

name: شَخْص
roots: ش-خ-ص (to stand out, to appear): a person; فرد (an individual — one of a number)

name: مَثِيل
roots: م-ث-ل (to be like): one of a kind — a running instance of a product

name: مُضِيف
roots: ض-ي-ف (a guest): the one who receives guests — a machine that hosts

name: مضيف افتراضي
roots: ف-ر-ض (to posit, to suppose): a host that is posited, not a body — a rented virtual server

name: نِطاق
roots: ن-ط-ق (to gird: a girdle, a range): a domain of the DNS — اسم النطاق, a domain name

name: خِدْمة
roots: خ-د-م (to serve): a service offered

name: بَرْنامَج
roots: Persian barnāme (bar + nāme: what is set down in writing): a program

name: تَصْمِيم
roots: ص-م-م (to resolve firmly): a design

name: جَلْسة
roots: ج-ل-س (to sit): a sitting — an agent's session, in which its acts are made

name: عَقْد
roots: ع-ق-د (to tie a knot): a contract

name: حَديقة
roots: ح-د-ق (to surround: a garden walled round): a garden this one records — as الحَديقة (section:manifest)

name: وَثِيقة
roots: و-ث-ق (to be firm, to trust): what is made fast and relied on — a document

name: حَدَث
roots: ح-د-ث (to happen, to be new): an event

name: عُنْوان
roots: عنوان (ʿunwān: the heading of a letter): what a bean is called

name: خُلاصة
roots: خ-ل-ص (to be pure, to come clear): the gist — one sentence of what a bean is

name: وُسوم
roots: و-س-م (to brand, to mark): marks — a bean's tags

name: استِحقاق
roots: ح-ق-ق (to be true, to become a right): the day a clause falls due — the first, when it repeats; تاريخ الاستحقاق (the due date)

name: تَكْرار
roots: ك-ر-ر (to return): how a clause repeats — each month of a calendar, six times

name: إشعار مسبق
roots: ش-ع-ر (to perceive: making aware) + س-ب-ق (to go before): how long before it falls due a reader is told

name: حالة
roots: ح-و-ل (to turn): how a clause stands — in force, met, waived, broken, disputed; الحال (term:status) is the retired table's

name: مِقْدار
roots: ق-د-ر (to measure out): how much — money, time, anything

name: مدّة السريان
roots: م-د-د (to stretch: a span) + س-ر-ي (to travel by night, to flow: a contract's being in force): the window in which a clause holds

name: مدّة الاحتساب
roots: م-د-د (a span) + ح-س-ب (to count): the window an amount is counted within — ninety days within any hundred and eighty

name: مُسْتَعْمِلوه
roots: ع-م-ل (to work, as استعمال, `use`): its users — the entries whose spans use the allowance: a person's stays, their leave

name: شرط السريان
roots: ش-ر-ط (a condition) + س-ر-ي (to flow: being in force): what brings a clause into force, where that is not a day

name: لكلّ
roots: ك-ل-ل (all, each): the clause occurs once for each bean or entry a reading holds

name: نِسبةً من
roots: ن-س-ب (to relate: a proportion): what the clause's amount is a share of, read from each occurrence

name: استحقاق نسبي
roots: ح-ق-ق (to fall due) + ن-س-ب (to relate): when a clause falls due relative to another position, read each time

name: بحسب الصفة
roots: ح-س-ب (to reckon: according to) + صفة (a capacity): every party whose capacity this is, each bound alike

name: للقِسْم
roots: ق-س-م (to apportion): for the part of what the agreement concerns that this clause is for — of two purchases, the one paid in six instalments

name: البند المسوّى
roots: بند (a clause) + س-و-ي (to make level): the clause a payment settles

name: مَرّة
roots: م-ر-ر (to pass: a time, once): which occurrence of the clause it settles — each sale, each booking

name: مبلغ مسدَّد
roots: ب-ل-غ (to reach: an amount) + س-د-د (to stop a gap: paid off): how much of the occurrence it settles

name: إيضاح
roots: و-ض-ح (to be clear): a remark on a settlement; ملاحظة is the note beside the roles
